openai/gpt-5-mini.mistake: Two lines misuse the exclusive-or (⊕). ∀x (p_1(x) ⊕ p_12(x)) and ∀x (p_6(x) ⊕ p_12(x)) force that for every individual exactly one of the two predicates holds. The NL wording “distinct and separate pursuits” more naturally states a conceptual distinction (or at most that they are mutually exclusive as properties) rather than asserting that every person must have exactly one of them true. If the intent was only to say the properties are different or mutually exclusive (no one can have both), the correct formalization would be ∀x ¬(p_1(x) ∧ p_12(x)) (or a statement about predicates being distinct), not an exclusive-or that additionally requires at least one to hold for every x. Because of these mismatches, the overall mapping is not fully correct.
